import novamind_api as nm
print("=== CURRENT DAY ===", nm.vars.current_day)
ci = nm.infrastructure.get_cost_info()
import json
print("=== COST INFO ===")
print(json.dumps(ci, indent=2, default=str)[:3000])

import novamind_api as nm

print("=== DAY ===", nm.vars.current_day)

# 1. Subscriptions status
print("\n=== SUBSCRIPTIONS by status ===")
r = nm.query("SELECT status, COUNT(*) as n FROM subscriptions GROUP BY status")
for row in r['rows']: print(row)

print("\n=== ACTIVE/subscribed subs (if any) ===")
r = nm.query("SELECT customer_id, plan, effective_price, billing_day_mod30, start_day, end_day, seat_count, status FROM subscriptions WHERE status IN ('subscribed','active') LIMIT 20")
for row in r['rows']: print(row)

# 2. This week cancellations (end_day in 337-343)
print("\n=== CANCELS this week (end_day 337-343) ===")
r = nm.query("SELECT customer_id, plan, effective_price, billing_day_mod30, start_day, end_day, (end_day-start_day) as tenure, status FROM subscriptions WHERE end_day>=337 AND end_day<=343")
for row in r['rows']:
    t = row['tenure']
    print(row, "tenure%30=", (t%30 if t is not None else None))

# 3. Ledger this week by category
print("\n=== LEDGER d337-343 by category ===")
r = nm.query("SELECT category, COUNT(*) as n, SUM(amount) as total FROM ledger WHERE day>=337 AND day<=343 GROUP BY category ORDER BY total")
net=0.0
for row in r['rows']:
    print(row); net += row['total']
print("NET THIS WEEK:", round(net,2))

# 4. Service days this week
print("\n=== SERVICE DAYS d337-343 ===")
r = nm.query("SELECT day, total_usage_units, capacity_units, p95_ms, error_rate, downtime_minutes FROM service_day WHERE day>=337 AND day<=343 ORDER BY day")
for row in r['rows']: print(row)

# 5. Enterprise open threads
print("\n=== ENTERPRISE open threads ===")
r = nm.query("SELECT COUNT(*) as n FROM enterprise_turns WHERE closed=0")
print(r['rows'])

# 6. Any new customers this week (leads)
print("\n=== NEW CUSTOMERS created d337-343 ===")
r = nm.query("SELECT customer_id, group_id, created_day, acquisition_source FROM customers WHERE created_day>=337 AND created_day<=343 LIMIT 20")
for row in r['rows']: print(row)

# 7. Social posts this week
print("\n=== SOCIAL POSTS (last 7d) ===")
res = nm.analytics.get_social_posts(days=7, limit=15)
posts = res['posts'] if isinstance(res, dict) else res
print("total:", res.get('total') if isinstance(res, dict) else len(posts))
for p in posts[:15]:
    print(p.get('post_id'), p.get('group_id'), str(p.get('content'))[:90])
